audit_result.proof_trace: The only input guard is a presence check (`!name`) at L47; neither a length bound nor any sanitization is applied to `name` before it is interpolated into `updatedNickname` and passed to `setNickname` → `member.setNickname()`. The final nickname (e.g., `${name}(${student_number})`) can exceed Discord's 32-char limit and carries unsanitized Unicode control characters or special chars verbatim into the Discord API call.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An authenticated caller sends `POST /api/nickname/update` with an arbitrarily long or specially crafted `name` (e.g., 80 Unicode chars or zero-width joiners); the value passes the `!name` check, is assembled into `updatedNickname`, and forwarded to the Discord API — either causing a predictable 500 due to length rejection or injecting visual spoofing characters into the member's Discord display name.

PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-007.text: Nickname input must be sanitized and length-bounded before passing to Discord API.
PROP-stem-bot-v21-inv-007.assertion: forall req: updateNickname(uid, name) => len(name) <= 32 && sanitized(name)
